description.value: Nando's is an international chain with roots in a 1987 Portuguese eatery in Johannesburg, South Africa, built around flame-grilled chicken marinated for 24 hours in PERi-PERi chili sauce. The Kerrisdale location sits on West 41st Avenue in a residential neighbourhood and offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery across a broad menu of chicken, sandwiches, salads, and sides. It is one of several BC locations in a chain operating across 23 countries.
